name: langchain-host
title: LangChain Host (both directions)

origin.source: Real @langchain/core + @langchain/openai + langchain 1.x (not shims): a BaseChatModel wrapped into the { generateText, streamText, decide } executor contract, and DynamicStructuredTool bridge tools driven by LangChain 1.x createAgent

comparison.purpose: Coexistence, not migration: Direction A wraps any LangChain chat model into the machine's three executor slots (so model config, callbacks, and env-var-driven LangSmith tracing keep working); Direction B hands a LangChain createAgent loop start_workflow/resume_workflow tools over the email-drafter machine. LangChain makes every model call; the machine owns control flow and legality.
